description: Head monocular RGB view and wrist extrinsics follow Astribot's official ManiSkill example, converted from SAPIEN +X-forward/+Z-up to USD -Z-forward/+Y-up. Other sensors remain task-oriented simulation mounts. Local coordinates are metres relative to the named link; this is not per-device hardware calibration.

head_camera_provenance.selected_view: Single RGB viewpoint of the head RGB-D camera; not a left/right stereo pair.
head_camera_provenance.scope: Official simulated head camera pose, resolution, vertical FOV and clipping planes. RGB-only press videos; optional ideal depth in the full sensor interface is not a stereo reconstruction or physical Femto Bolt model.

wrist_camera_provenance.scope: Official simulated wrist extrinsics only. Existing 640x480 image size and optical intrinsics are retained; official ManiSkill example uses 640x360 and vertical FOV 57 degrees. No claim of physical camera calibration.
